startup.global.error.permission_denied: The database is not writable. Check permissions for the data and temporary directories, then retry.

startup.global.error.startup_status_time: No startup status was received. Exit and reopen ZCode. If it fails again, provide the diagnostics to support.
startup.global.error.storage_full: Storage is full or a capacity limit was reached. Check the drives containing your data and system temporary directories. Free space or adjust the quota, then retry.
startup.global.error.transport_closed: The preparation process exited or disconnected. Exit and reopen ZCode to check the migration records again.
startup.global.error.unsupported_runtime: The configured Agent does not support storage preparation. Restore the bundled Agent, then reopen ZCode.
startup.global.exportLogsFailed: Failed to export logs. Please try again.
startup.global.exportedLogs: Logs exported. Opened in the file manager.
startup.global.help: ZCode will open when preparation finishes. Large histories may take longer. Please keep the app running.
